column4: retail bank, card dispute claims arrive as chats and forms, 9k a month, disputes team misses Reg E clocks, head of card operations wants a pilot in 8 weeks
commercial lender, relationship managers miss covenant breaches across 1,200 loans, credit decisions stay with credit officers, chief credit officer wants early warning in a quarter
specialty insurer, underwriting submissions arrive as broker emails with PDFs, underwriters re-key 30 fields per submission, head of underwriting wants quote turnaround halved by Q2
hospital, patient portal messages to nurses, 20k a month, nurses triage by hand and clinical red flags get buried, chief nursing officer wants a pilot in 10 weeks
pharmacy chain, insurance claim rejections that pharmacists fix by hand, 60k rejections a month, reject codes live in people's heads, VP pharmacy operations wants rework cut by a third this year
utility, outage and billing questions from customers in chat, 150k a month with storm surges, customer operations director wants faster answers without wrong outage promises
airline, disruption rebooking requests during irregular operations, 40k a day on bad days, agents miss compensation rules and time limits, VP customer care wants a pilot before summer
e-commerce retailer, returns and refund requests, 300k a month, refund fraud and policy exceptions handled by hand, head of customer service wants refund cost and handle time down by Q3
B2B SaaS company, account managers need next-best actions on 3,000 accounts, churn and expansion signals sit in five tools, chief revenue officer wants net revenue retention up this year
state agency, caseworkers review benefits applications, 50k a month, backlog drives appeals and complaints, agency director wants decisions faster with accessibility and fair treatment guaranteed
law firm, contract clause review against a playbook, 2,000 contracts a year, associates miss deviations and work is privileged, managing partner wants review time halved with citations
recruiting team, screening 40k applications a year, recruiters cannot read them all and fairness is a legal risk, head of talent wants time to shortlist halved and AI never deciding
manufacturer, maintenance work orders from operator shift logs across 12 plants, safety issues get lost in free text, VP operations wants safety escalations caught and planner time cut

finance team, accounts payable invoice matching exceptions, 25k invoices a month with 15% exceptions, three-way match failures handled by email, controller wants exception handling time halved with no payment made by AI

university, student support questions to an assistant, 80k a year across admissions, financial aid and wellbeing, some students are minors, dean of students wants faster answers with wellbeing escalated to people

asset manager, compliance surveillance of advisor communications, 2M messages a month with 98% false positives, reviewers burn out, chief compliance officer wants true escalations caught with far fewer false alarms
credit union, member requests for password resets and address changes, 30k a month handled by agents, head of member services wants them automated but the team is not sure AI is even needed
